lane: B - national / federal / private / global sources (state & city sources are lane A)
rule: STRICT clear-green only: terms must EXPLICITLY allow commercial use and redistribution (US federal work / public domain, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, ODbL, CDLA-Permissive, ODC-BY/PDDL, MIT/BSD/OFL for code+fonts, open-government licences, Copernicus free-full-open). Disclaimer-only, terms-unstated, 'verify', non-commercial, notify/permission-required, fee-for-commercial, or platform-wrapped (e.g. Esri MLA) = grey/red -> remove or replace.
method: Grepped every URL in usa/*.py and mpls/*.py; ArcGIS items checked via sharing/rest item licenseInfo; licence pages read with Python requests and the built-in browser (no Firecrawl, no terms accepted).

removal_list.alternative: Self-hosted Overpass (or osmium/DuckDB) on a Geofabrik US state extract or the OSM planet file (same ODbL data).
Query a local OSM planet/Geofabrik extract (osmium tags-filter / DuckDB) or a self-hosted QLever.
BTS National Transportation Noise Map rasters downloaded from BTS directly (https://www.bts.gov/geospatial/national-transportation-noise-map), US federal work.
EIA U.S. Energy Atlas 'Power Plants' layer served by EIA itself (atlas.eia.gov), US federal work.
OpenStreetMap power=line / power=minor_line with voltage (ODbL) from a local OSM extract.
EIA U.S. Energy Atlas 'Petroleum Product Pipelines' layer (atlas.eia.gov), US federal work.
FHFA HPI annual ZIP5/tract (already fetched as fhfa_hpi) for the index; ACS B25077 for levels. For mpls/money.py use FHFA ZIP5 HPI 2025->latest instead of ZHVI-since-Jan-2026.
No clean equivalent for live listings; drop realtor_zip. Optional context: ACS B25004 for-sale vacancy and Census BPS permits (public domain).
FFIEC Average Prime Offer Rates (APOR) weekly tables published by the FFIEC/CFPB (ffiec.cfpb.gov rate-spread tool, US federal work) for 30-yr and 15-yr fixed; label as APOR, not PMMS.
USGS PAD-US (Protected Areas Database, public domain) filtered to Mang_Name = BOR for Reclamation recreation lands.
Run usa/sky_catalog.py --strict (all star rows from the IAU Catalog of Star Names, CC BY) or source magnitudes from a US-government catalogue with stated public-domain status.
BTS NTAD National Transit Map Stops (CC BY 3.0 US, includes Metro Transit stops) for stop locations; drop live departures.
Keep LiDAR-derived trees only (USGS 3DEP, public domain), or the City of Minneapolis public tree inventory if its portal states an open licence (lane A).

not_in_scope_here: State/city sources (Hennepin, Ramsey, MnGeo, TxGIO, Colorado DRAPP, MnDOT AADT, CDOT, NY parks, Texas/Austin/Denver SODA, city adapters) -> lane A
Satellite research JSONs list many missions (JAXA, EUMETSAT, ISRO, Planet...) that no code fetches; only the imagery.py LIC entries are audited here

sources.name: d3-celestial stars.8.json (star positions/magnitudes, from XHIP/Hipparcos)
sources.provider: Olaf Frohn; upstream ESA Hipparcos via XHIP
sources.licence_quote: Repo is BSD-3, but the values derive from the ESA Hipparcos catalogue, which ESA distributes under CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO (commercial use needs ESA authorisation).
sources.reason: Upstream non-commercial licence ('verify upstream' in code). Star positions are arguably facts, but strict rule treats 'verify' as grey.
sources.alternative: Run usa/sky_catalog.py --strict (all star rows from the IAU Catalog of Star Names, CC BY) or source magnitudes from a US-government catalogue with stated public-domain status.
